items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Mary McPartland was down there and we did a show down there.

ctx.x: He wouldn't say nothing. You'd tell him that's a great concert and then we went down here to Georgetown, I think I was blind then, I went down there with him and Mary McPartland was down there and we did a show down there.
You were blind before Duke died.
